name: Gen 3-9 Regions & Levels Pack (14 Unique Maps)
author: HyruleChosenOne
description: 14 region-faithful procedural levels across Hoenn, Sinnoh, Unova, Kalos, Alola, Galar, and Paldea using the updated Modding API with unique topographies, landmarks, decorative regional scenery, custom textures, and official region OSTs.

customLevels.name: Petalburg Woods (Hoenn)
customLevels.desc: Mossy emerald Hoenn woodland with sunlit trails, ancient giant trunks, mossy clearings, and the Petalburg Moss Shrine.

customLevels.name: Mt. Chimney Caldera (Hoenn)
customLevels.desc: Smoking Hoenn volcanic caldera encircled by a molten magma moat, basalt bridges, cable pylons, and steaming ash cliffs.

customLevels.name: Mt. Coronet Spear Pillar (Sinnoh)
customLevels.desc: High-altitude Sinnoh snow summit ascending along a fluted marble pilgrimage causeway to the ancient Spear Pillar acropolis.

customLevels.name: Eterna Twilight Woods (Sinnoh)
customLevels.desc: Misty dusk Sinnoh woodland split by a dark mossy forest creek and lantern-lined iron gates ascending to the Old Chateau.

customLevels.name: Relic Desert Resort (Unova)
customLevels.desc: Wind-sculpted Unova desert dunes sweeping around the sunken sandstone courtyard of Relic Castle, obelisks, and guardian statues.

customLevels.name: Dragonspiral Tower (Unova)
customLevels.desc: Northern Unova autumn highlands with a grand ascending spiral approach, stone bridges, and a tranquil moat surrounding Dragonspiral Tower.

customLevels.name: Azure Bay Coast (Kalos)
customLevels.desc: Sunlit Kalos turquoise bay with a crescent white-sand cove, coastal limestone headland, offshore tidal islet sandbar, and Azure Sea Arch.

customLevels.name: Reflection Crystal Cave (Kalos)
customLevels.desc: Enclosed Kalos crystal cavern with geometric mirror-crystal terraces, iridescent amethyst pools, and glowing mirrored crystal walls.

customLevels.name: Melemele Tropical Shore (Alola)
customLevels.desc: Sun-drenched Alolan tropical island cove with golden palm beaches, turquoise lagoon, tiki torches, and the Ruins of Conflict.

customLevels.name: Wela Volcano Park (Alola)
customLevels.desc: Akala Island volcanic cone with a winding spiral Fire Trial ascent, radial obsidian fissures, flaming braziers, and the Wela Crown Altar.

customLevels.name: Galar Wild Area (Galar)
customLevels.desc: Expansive rolling Galar highland moors split by a meandering river and stone crossings, dotted with standing stone circles and Power Spot dens.

customLevels.name: Crown Tundra Glacier (Galar)
customLevels.desc: Frozen Galar alpine tundra carved by a glistening frozen ice fjord, snow-buried ruin arches, frost lanterns, and the Crown Shrine.

customLevels.name: Asado Titan Mesa (Paldea)
customLevels.desc: Sunbaked Paldean red-terracotta badlands defined by sheer flat-topped stratified mesas, dry canyon arroyos, hoodoos, and the Titan Arch.

customLevels.name: Area Zero Great Crater (Paldea)
customLevels.desc: Colossal inverted Paldean Great Crater plunging across verdant crystal tiers toward Zero Lab beacons, crystal springs, and the Terastal Spire.

customMusic.name: Mt. Coronet (DPPt)

customMusic.desc: Kalos Azure Bay coastal adventure theme

customMusic.name: Battle! Totem Pokémon / Wela Volcano (SM)
customMusic.desc: Alola Wela Volcano Park trial theme

customMusic.name: Wild Area (SwSh)
customMusic.desc: Galar Wild Area open highlands theme

customMusic.name: Asado Desert (SV)
customMusic.desc: Paldea Asado Titan Mesa desert theme

customMusic.name: Tera Raid / Area Zero (SV)
customMusic.desc: Paldea Area Zero Great Crater crystal theme
